verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
My heart burst at its banks
Spilling with beauty and goodness
I pour it out as a song to my King
Shaping the rivers into words

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
What grace pours from Your lips
The sound calls the midnight to morning
The melody turns my winter to spring
I echo it now in my worship
I echo it now in my worship

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Ten thousand strong, You’re the fairest of all
Fairest in heaven and earth
Of the children of men, You’re the fairest of them
Fairest in heaven and earth

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Your heart burst at the seams
Flowing with blood and with water
A song of love pouring out from the tree
Singing, “For the joy set before Me”
Singing, “For the joy set before Me”

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You ransomed Your bride
On the day that You died
Ascended to heaven in glory
She stands clothed in white
With her head lifted high
Singing, “Come and return in Your glory”

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
You ransomed Your bride
On the day that You died
Ascended to heaven in glory
We stand clothed in white
With our voice lifted high
Singing, “Come and return in Your glory”
